page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Benathy king?

A male individual served as the king of the Benathy species on an astronomical object located in Wild Space. visited Benath with his army to negotiate the end of the Benathy's conquest of local planets and to invite the Benathy to submit to the First Order. While meeting with Ren, Kristoff recalled Vader's visit and regicide, and Ren, too, ultimately killed the king after they both refused to submit and annoyed him.

The king was first mentioned in the comic one-shot Age of Resistance - Kylo Ren 1. The comic was written by Tom Taylor and published by Marvel Comics
